title: Flaky: test_independent_s3_reviewers_cannot_create_two_active_votes lets JournalConflict escape
description: src/decision_flywheel/s3_review_storage_test.py: two threads race record_vote; the loser sometimes raises decision_flywheel.journal.JournalConflict ('S3 head changed; read current authority before retry') instead of ValueError, so the test fails. Measured 2026-10-24: 3/20 failures at c279037 (before PR #115) and 4/20 after, so it predates the request-efficiency change. Fix either ReviewStore.record_vote (retry or convert a CAS conflict into the duplicate-vote refusal) or the test's expectation; decide which is the intended contract.
